description: This file contains unit tests for the MSTeams probe module, verifying credential handling and token acquisition logic using mocking and testing frameworks.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Mocked class representing the Microsoft Teams App, providing methods to retrieve bot tokens and graph tokens, with simulated error throwing based on mock state.

methods.name: getBotToken
methods.description: Asynchronous method returning a mock bot token or throwing an error if the mock state indicates a token error.

methods.name: getAppGraphToken
methods.description: Asynchronous method returning a mock graph token or throwing an error if the mock state indicates a token error.

ctags.name: cfg
ctags.pattern: /^    const cfg = { enabled: true } as unknown as MSTeamsConfig;$/
